!
ip route default 192.0.2.254

!
snmp-agent ip enable
snmp-agent ip community example-ro ro
snmp-agent ipv6 enable
snmp-agent ipv6 community example-ro ro
snmp-agent ipv6 host 2001:db8:0:162::1 example-ro version 2
!
ntp server 2001:db8:0:123::1
!
syslog ipv6 host 2001:db8:0:50::1
syslog ipv6 source 2001:db8:0:2::1
!
watch-group wg-v6 10
  event 10 ipv6 unreach-host 2001:db8:ff::10 GigaEthernet1.0 source 2001:db8:0:2::1
  probe-counter variance 1
  probe-timer variance 10
  action 10 ip shutdown-route 0.0.0.0/0 192.0.2.254
!
network-monitor wg-v6 enable
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/24
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0

  ipv6 address 2001:db8:0:2::1/64
  no shutdown
